title: Voice Profile
description: A schema defining the communication voice, tone, and brand constraints for a profile.

tone_keywords.description: Keywords describing the emotional quality or atmosphere of the communication.

style_keywords.description: Keywords describing the structure or manner of writing (e.g., concise, poetic).

formality_level.description: The level of professional distance or social intimacy in communication.

empathy_level.description: The degree of emotional sensitivity and understanding shown to the audience.

brand_phrases.description: Specific phrases or slogans frequently used to reinforce brand identity.

do_not_say_list.description: Words, phrases, or topics that are strictly prohibited in communication.

greeting_style.description: The preferred method of initiating contact or starting a message.

signoff_style.description: The preferred method of concluding a message or saying goodbye.
